why: This is not an 'unverified, ask staff' case, it is a documented no. A diner records the soba itself as 二八 (20% wheat binder), Tabelog and Retty both file the shop under カレーうどん/うどん, and Tabelog's keyword list includes カツ丼. There is no wheat-free item and nothing for staff to confirm; 'ask' invites a celiac to make a phone call that can only end one way.

The tsuyu's defining ingredient is 焼き鯖干し (grilled dried mackerel) dashi and the house bowl is 鴨せいろ (duck). Fish dashi is in the dipping sauce that arrives with every soba order, so there is no vegan path even by omission - 'no' is the honest label, not 'ask'.
